items.why: A day before the machine's first master migration (10-10 22:32:42) starts with 自动囤货's buy lists in the checkbox shape (install.set_tasks_before, the real 10-10 master); the current relay rewrites them into MaaEnd's switch + Items shape at its first boot (migrate_maaend_options) and says so on Server酱, an info push. The machine's code of this day did not have the migration yet.

MaaEnd-05-29-15 (协议空间, 5 claims, last reading 118/360, a claim after it): the collector books 78 sanity left by the per-claim rule 4efee4f2 settled for exactly this run; #20 still wants the last reading minus the largest drop (0) and calls 78 wrong. The machine's #20 passed (relay.log 10-08 11:13:11) only because the old collector booked 0 too. Not fixed at 79da6cb5: reported as a relay bug (daysim-R3). Fixed 2026-10-13 (daysim-R3): #20 now prices the claim after the last reading by its own payout (折金票 68000 = 160, 34000 = 80), independently of the collector.

Depends on the history the relay starts the day with, so may. The 09:00 shift really ran until 11:12 (MaaEnd 09:30:20-10:30:36 failed on 自动采集, then MaaEnd's update and two retries). check_overrun's limit is the longest of the last 7 days whose shift was clean, needing 3 such days (runwatch.planned_minutes). Gate mode seeds the machine's 10-07 ledger, where that day's code booked AUTO-MAS's 09:52:42 MaaEnd update step as a failed attempt (row 4): 10-07 is not clean, only 10-02 and 10-03 are, the limit falls back to 10-05's 150 minutes and nothing fires. Chain mode carries the current code's 10-07 ledger, which books no row for an update step (R34, d9f3fd12): 10-07 is a clean 52-minute day, the limit is 53 + 30 minutes, and at 10:23 the shift is still running - the overrun alarm check_overrun is built to send (cad968b5), as the machine did on 10-02 23:43:30.

items.why: Ledger #29: route 10 walked through 「战斗中无法使用」 (2026.10.08-10.59.41.495 inside its window of MaaEnd-06-34-21) and gathered nothing, so the per-route retry re-runs it before power-off (before the fix: 「全部路线走通，没有要补的」). The sim does not model MaaEnd's MXU API, so the retry gets no verdict and goes to the group; this entry proves the retry was started for the blocked route. On the machine a route the retry gathers is daily report only, one it still misses goes to the group.

The retry's verdict comes from MaaEnd (MXU's API and maafw.log node lines), which the sim does not model: here MXU never answers, so the retry has no verdict and goes to the group. On the machine a route the retry gathers is daily report only, one it still misses goes to the group.
